mapper.select: SELECT t2.id, t2.code, t2.name, t2.is_system, t2.status, t2.remark, t2.create_user_id, t2.update_user_id, t2.create_time, t2.update_time, t2.is_delete FROM sys_user_role t1 LEFT JOIN sys_role t2 ON t1.role_id = t2.id WHERE t1.user_id = #{userId} AND t1.is_delete = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user t3 WHERE t3.id = t1.user_id AND t3.status = 1 AND t3.is_delete = 0) AND t2.status = 1 AND t2.is_delete = 0

SELECT DISTINCT t2.code FROM sys_user_role t1 INNER JOIN sys_role t2 ON t1.role_id = t2.id WHERE t1.user_id = #{userId} AND t1.is_delete = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user t3 WHERE t3.id = t1.user_id AND t3.status = 1 AND t3.is_delete = 0) AND t2.status = 1 AND t2.is_delete = 0
